user.title: Freezer
user.description: Freezer inventory with a code and label per package. Set up categories, QR codes and printers afterwards via Configure.

data.melden_aan: Phone for notifications after a scan
data.dashboard: Dashboard path for the Open button

data_description.qr: Puts a QR code on the label (can be switched per category). Scanning it with a phone running the HA app gives a notification with Take all, Take part and Open.
data_description.melden_aan: Normally the notification goes to the phone that scanned. Pick a phone here if that does not work.
data_description.dashboard: For example /lovelace/freezer. Empty = no Open button.

data_description.prefix: 1 to 3 letters for the code, e.g. M gives M-0012. Cannot be changed later.
data_description.dagen: Sets the 'use before' date (freeze date + days).
data_description.qr: Only works when QR codes are also on under General.

categorie_verwijderen.title: Delete category
categorie_verwijderen.description: Only possible when no packages of that category are left in the freezer.

labelprinter.title: Label printer
labelprinter.description: Every label is drawn as a black and white PNG and its path is passed to an action, so any label printer with an HA action that prints an image works. Leave the action empty to only fire the event vriezer_label (with code, name, file) for your own automation.

data_description.label_veld: Name of the field in that action that gets the path.
data_description.label_extra: Sent along as a JSON object, e.g. with dichtheid 2 for Fichero.
data_description.label_breedte: In printer dots. Fichero D11s (30 x 14 mm): 240 x 96.
data_description.label_pauze: Wait before the next label. The Fichero gets confused when labels follow each other quickly; 5 s works. Other printers: 0.

bonprinter.title: Receipt printer
bonprinter.description: Prints an overview of the inventory on a receipt. The text is passed to an action, e.g. of an ESC/POS integration. Empty = only the event vriezer_bon (with the text).

data_description.bon_actie: For example the print text action of your receipt printer integration. To test: persistent_notification.create with field message.

error.name_taken: This name already exists or is empty
error.prefix_taken: These code letters are already in use
error.unknown_action: This action does not exist in HA
error.bad_json: Not a valid JSON object (between curly braces)
error.category_in_use: There are still packages of this category in the freezer
error.last_category: At least one category must remain

toevoegen.name: Add
toevoegen.description: Puts one or more packages in the freezer. Each package gets a code; its label goes to the queue (or is printed right away with print).

categorie.name: Category
categorie.description: Name or code letter; empty = the first category.

hoeveelheid.name: Amount per package
hoeveelheid.description: For example 400 g, 1 kg or 3 pcs.

regel.name: Line
regel.description: Instead of name and amount: 'Mince - 400 g' or 'Mince 400g'.

pakjes.name: Number of packages
pakjes.description: Each package gets its own code and label.

op_voor.name: Use before
op_voor.description: Empty = freeze date plus the days of the category.

printen.name: Print now
printen.description: Otherwise the label goes to the queue.

van_boodschappenlijst.name: From shopping list
van_boodschappenlijst.description: Moves a line from a to-do list (e.g. the butcher) to the freezer and ticks it off there with 'naar vriezer'.

printen.name: Print now
printen.description: Otherwise the label goes to the queue.

uithalen.name: Take out
uithalen.description: Takes a package out of the freezer, completely or in part.

hoeveelheid.name: Amount taken
hoeveelheid.description: For example 200 g. Empty (and no rest) = everything.

rest.name: Amount left
rest.description: Instead of the amount taken: what is left, e.g. 200 g.

terugzetten.name: Put back
terugzetten.description: Puts a removed package back in the freezer (undo).

wijzigen.name: Edit
wijzigen.description: Changes name, amount or dates of a package.

hoeveelheid.name: Amount
hoeveelheid.description: What is in it now, e.g. 300 g; empty = unknown.

verwijderen.name: Delete
verwijderen.description: Deletes a package completely, without history (for mistakes). Used up: use Take out.

labels_printen.name: Print labels
labels_printen.description: Prints the labels in the queue, or those of the given codes (also again).

codes.name: Codes
codes.description: Empty = the whole queue; otherwise e.g. V-0004, V-0005.

uit_wachtrij.name: Remove from queue
uit_wachtrij.description: Marks labels as printed without printing.

bon_printen.name: Overview on receipt
bon_printen.description: Prints the inventory on the receipt printer; the response holds the text.

importeren.name: Import
importeren.description: Takes over packages from to-do lists in the old format (line 'Name - amount', description 'V-0001 | ingevroren dd/mm/yyyy').
